order_note: Inbound edge from D_REVIEW_ON_TIME is contradicted: the guideline has the program terminate on non-return of the review application, not a caseworker task; the D_ROBOT_OUTCOME edge is not in the guideline.
corrections: The guideline gives reason-specific termination-month rules (table and sections, p. 73-75: e.g. month the right/costs arise or cease, month after moving or death, 7th month after imprisonment, latest 4th month for an empty dwelling) but no separate 'determine date' task; it is part of the termination itself. Non-return of the annual review is terminated programmatically, not by a caseworker.

order_note: Guideline describes no impulse/robot chain after this event.
corrections: The guideline frames the trigger as a single-person or married/cohabiting two-person household member becoming entitled to the pensioners' housing allowance (not as Kela 'granting a pension or rehabilitation benefit'); work-pension-law kuntoutusraha is listed among benefits that do NOT give entitlement to it (p. 9), and no system event or work-queue 'impulse' is mentioned.
The guideline never mentions impulse tasks, a work queue or a work management system (only a pointer to a 'Seurantatyöt' process section for foster-placement follow-up on p. 10).

evidence.quote: Ruokakunnalla ei ole oikeutta yleiseen asumistukeen, jos ruokakunnalla on oikeus eläkkeensaajien asumistukeen.

corrections: Guideline states the exclusion rule and refers to a lighter correction procedure (kevennetty oikaisumenettely) for retroactively granted precluding benefits, but describes no software robot or automated impact check; its imperatives are addressed to the staff member, and 'ohjelmallisesti' is used only for the annual review letter and non-return termination.

No automated outcome branching, 'exclusion rule' transfer to a caseworker or 'no effect' outcome is described in the guideline; it only says the allowance is terminated when entitlement to the pensioners' housing allowance begins (p. 74-75).

corrections: The only programmatic (ohjelmallisesti) termination with a decision in the guideline is triggered by non-return of the annual review application, not by a pension/rehabilitation-benefit check; automated revision decisions are not mentioned, and the guideline says 'program', not 'robot'.

evidence.quote: Jos vuokralainen laiminlyö vuokran maksamisen kokonaan tai osittain kahden perättäisen kuukauden ajan, tuki voidaan vuokranantajan pyynnöstä maksaa suoraan vuokranantajalle ilman tuensaajan suostumusta (YAL 25 § 2 mom.).

actor_in_guideline: Tenant/benefit recipient (vuokralainen laiminlyö); landlord only makes the request
corrections: The condition matches (rent wholly or partly unpaid for two consecutive months), but in the guideline the omission is the tenant's ('vuokralainen laiminlyö') and the trigger for Kela is the landlord's request; the payment redirection is permissive ('voidaan').

evidence.quote: tuki voidaan vuokranantajan pyynnöstä maksaa suoraan vuokranantajalle ilman tuensaajan suostumusta (YAL 25 § 2 mom.).
Vuokranantajan on ilmoitettava Kelalle, jos • asumistuen saajan oikeus pitää huoneistoa hallinnassaan päättyy tai • asumistuen saaja muuttaa pois asunnosta.

corrections: The landlord's action is a request that Kela pay the allowance directly to the landlord ('vuokranantajan pyynnöstä'), not a mere report of unpaid rent; the landlord's statutory notification duty covers end of possession and moving out, not unpaid rent. This resolves the map's uncertainty: landlord initiation is the documented trigger.

evidence.quote: • Kuule tuensaajaa ennen maksun siirtämistä vuokranantajalle

corrections: The guideline orders staff to hear the recipient (kuuleminen) before the payment is moved to the landlord, i.e. a formal opportunity to be heard rather than a mere notification, so automation_class 'notification' understates it.

evidence.quote: Jos vuokralainen laiminlyö vuokran maksamisen kokonaan tai osittain kahden perättäisen kuukauden ajan, tuki voidaan vuokranantajan pyynnöstä maksaa suoraan vuokranantajalle ilman tuensaajan suostumusta (YAL 25 § 2 mom.).

order_note: Guideline places the hearing of the recipient before the transfer decision but does not say where an assessment sits.
corrections: Guideline gives only the objective condition (two consecutive months, whole or partial non-payment, on landlord's request) and the discretionary 'voidaan'; it does not mention weighing the recipient's circumstances or a separate assessment step.

evidence.quote: tuki voidaan vuokranantajan pyynnöstä maksaa suoraan vuokranantajalle ilman tuensaajan suostumusta (YAL 25 § 2 mom.).
